result.title: Neural Surrogate Modeling of Ultrasonic Wave Propagation in Heterogeneous Media
result.summary: Neural surrogates provide computationally efficient auto-regressive modeling of wave propagation, enabling e.g. fast inverse solutions. Despite recent progress, the current surrogates are not yet sufficient for the needs of ultrasonic sensing, characterized by high frequency and heterogeneous propagation media. We show how methods building on Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) fail to capture essential signal features, such as reflections, whereas U-Net -based methods learn the wave fields well but lack the ability to transfer information across different spatial scales. We then propose a new surrogate that captures the best of the two worlds, by integrating FNOs and local-integral resampling into a U-Net architecture. We show it can be trained on limited data, and that the predictions are robust to input noise and work across spatial scales.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究以神经代理模型自回归预测非均匀介质中的超声波动，指出 FNO 类方法会丢失反射等关键信号特征、U-Net 类方法难以跨空间尺度传递信息，进而提出将 FNO 与局部积分重采样融入 U-Net 的混合架构，并展示其小数据训练与跨尺度、抗噪声表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「自回归状态更新＋多尺度融合」的架构设计，以及关于细节特征丢失与跨尺度信息传递不足的失败分析，可能对应 LVR 中 latent 状态能否保留细粒度视觉证据、以及跨尺度信息在推理状态中如何传播的问题，可供核查，但属推测性迁移。
